name: Onyx Robotic and Automation Pvt Ltd
india_angle: Onyx Robotic and Automation Pvt Ltd has a significant presence in India with facilities in Pune, Saswad-Pune, Jejuri, and Chennai.
summary: Onyx Robotic and Automation Pvt Ltd specializes in providing test and measurement equipment, inspection automation solutions, and contract manufacturing services primarily for the 3C industry. Their offerings include advanced tools for dimensional and functional checks, as well as vision and laser-based inspection solutions.
